Output is a separate black track with no original clip, so the original sound is absent. This is only because the clip was never included.

must.item: Narration fits without clipped ending; no music or captions
must.why: No captions are visible. Peak -25.8 dB is quiet. Clipping cannot be judged without hearing it.

The cost was 240 credits for a black video.
